visualCharacteristics.variantDescriptor: Unequal 2 columns: wide body copy left, narrow aside with blue top rule, small uppercase label and arrow link right.
visualCharacteristics.sectionStylingNotes: Two fixed columns: wide intro paragraph (left, about 2/3) and a narrow "HELPFUL LINKS" aside (right) with a blue top rule, small uppercase label and an uppercase arrow link "CONTACT US".
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Intro body copy beside a narrow helpful-links aside

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 body copy; cell 2 aside (short label paragraph followed by link paragraphs)
contentPattern.description: Intro paragraph beside a Helpful Links aside (label + Contact Us link)

usage: Use for an intro paragraph with a narrow related/helpful links aside on the right.
reuseGuidance: Reuse when columns are deliberately unequal (main 2/3, aside 1/3). The last cell is always treated as the aside.
